lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Wednesday's San Miguel County BOCC meeting, where three Land Use Code amendments go to public hearing — including changes to who qualifies as a 'Qualified Owner,' a wildfire-area code update, and a continued hearing on nonconforming lots, all moving toward formal votes. The Open Space Commission meets Monday to pick a preferred trail alignment for the Valley Floor River Trail's first reach, with three wetland-sensitive routes on the table. Mountain Village's Design Review Board takes up three multifamily projects Thursday, and the Ouray County Planning Commission holds a virtual work session on rewriting its definitions section — the kind of quiet change that shapes everything downstream.

notable.stake: Commission picks River Trail alignment from three wetland-area alternatives.
